result.title: Softmax-Free Attention in Spiking Transformers as the Zero-Temperature Limit of Two-Level Systems
result.summary: Spiking Transformers achieve energy efficiency by discarding softmax normalization in favor of thresholded, binary attention. However, this removal breaks the thermodynamic framework used to analyze attention networks, as the normalized measure and partition function cease to exist. We restore this theoretical foundation by proving that softmax-free spiking attention operates exactly as the zero-temperature limit of a product of independent two-level systems. This correspondence places spiking attention strictly in the frozen ordered phase of the thermodynamic phase diagram for all inputs. Consequently, the entropic cost of organizing attention collapses, replaced by a Landauer-type physical floor governed by action-potential generation. Furthermore, this ordered-phase pinning mathematically explains the optimization difficulty caused by vanishing surrogate gradients. We validate this theory with forward-relaxation experiments, placing both standard and neuromorphic attention mechanisms on a unified thermodynamic axis.

AI.brief_summary: 论文证明脉冲 Transformer 中无 softmax 的阈值化二值注意力恰为独立二能级系统之积的零温极限，用热力学相图统一刻画标准与神经形态注意力，并据此解释替代梯度消失导致的优化困难。
AI.relevance_reason: 用熵成本与物理下界刻画注意力组织的视角，可能与 latent 推理中注意力熵坍缩、信息坍缩以及每步计算成本的核算形成类比线索，但本文不涉及多模态推理状态，能否借鉴需核查。
